_Table 3. The configuration information accessible by the_ `CPUCFG` _instruction_

|Word|Bit|Annotation||Implication|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|number|number||||
|0x0|31:0|PRID|Processor Identity||</previous>

|0x1|2|PGMMU|1 indicates that the MMU supports page mapping mode|
|0x1|3|IOCSR|1 indicates support for the IOCSR instruction|
|0x1|11:4|PALEN|The supported physical address bits PALEN value minus 1|
|0x1|19:12|VALEN|The supported virtual address bits VALEN value minus 1|
|0x1|20|UAL|1 indicates support for non-aligned memory access|
|0x1|21|RI|1 indicates support for page attribute of “Read Inhibit”|
|0x1|22|EP|1 indicates support for page attribute of “Execution Protection”|
|0x1|23|RPLV|1 indicates support for page attributes of RPLV|
|0x1|24|HP|1 indicates support for page attributes of huge page|
|0x1|25|CRC|1 indicates that support CRC instruction That is, information such as “Loongson3A5000 @ 2.5GHz”|
|0x1|26|MSG_INT|1 indicates that the external interrupt uses the message interrupt mode, otherwise it is the level interrupt line mode|</target>
